HEART Score for Major Cardiac Events

Predicts 6-week risk of major adverse cardiac event in chest pain patients

Original: Six AJ et al. Neth Heart J 2008
Validation: Multiple studies, >10,000 patients
6-Week MACE Risk:
• 0-3: Low (1.7%) - Consider discharge with outpatient follow-up
• 4-6: Moderate (20%) - Admit for further evaluation
• 7-10: High (72%) - Urgent intervention likely needed
MACE: Death, MI, or revascularization
